label: TP
reason: User input from request.getQueryString() flows directly to response output. Although a sanitization step exists in doSomething (replacing last char with Z), it is insufficient to neutralize XSS vectors (e.g., <script> tags remain intact or become malformed in ways browsers still execute). Additionally, X-XSS-Protection header is disabled.

evidence.note: Input decoded but otherwise passed to inner class without full sanitization
Weak sanitization only replaces last character, leaving dangerous substrings intact
Unsafe sink printing user data to response writer
X-XSS-Protection header explicitly disabled allowing browser attacks
